svg.text: Fig. 1 Layered architecture and trust boundaries
CLI (thin adapter: JSON envelope, exit codes, ui shell)
init | run | inspect | replay | challenge | recover | agent | experiment | effect | ui
Application Services (use cases; proposal capture; evidence binding)
runLab | inspectLab | replayLab | runContinuous | challenge | paired-* | ui-service
Kernel (domain-blind, pure)
numeric observations · ValueSpec · opaque tokens
expectation → choice → verify → learn
bounded planning · multi-scale context · belief gates
no I/O · no clock · no world names (invariant 8)
WorldPort boundary (domain semantics live here)
built-in: temperature · virtual-desktop · inventory · grid · queue
external JSONL: counter · repo · ci-ess · pv-station · ems · vpp
battery · inverter · meter · PV · charger · DR (device models)
digest-bound implementations · fail-closed state contract
ModelAdvisor / ModelPlanner (untrusted proposals)
OpenAI-compatible · real GLM verified · replay never calls model
LabStore (JSONL ledger + hash chain + snapshots + lock)
deterministic replay · crash recovery · ≤40 MiB · fail-closed
Evidence invariants: expectation before action · verify before learn · replay without side effects · fail-closed on unknown versions
four-layer confounder defence: world receipt → host forcing → kernel verify → ledger validation
